SPINR RIDER v8 — iOS App Store · 1290 × 2796

Frames 1–2 are a connected full-bleed pair: the tilted phone leaves
frame 1's right edge and continues on frame 2. Canada-wide positioning:
the headline carries "your fare stays home." with a maple-leaf
"Proudly Canadian rideshare." subtitle beneath it — Saskatchewan-
specific copy removed from marketing text.

FRAME 3 — faithful to ride-options.tsx: real production illustrations,
selected image full-size vs 0.59 unselected (the app's exact transform),
charcoal selected border + checkmark, per-row slashed prices in the
app's green. WELCOME75 = 75% off, computed exactly:
$22.99 → $5.75 · $29.75 → $7.44 · $31.40 → $7.85.
Promo code and fares are sample data.

SAMPLE DATA — swap before submitting: fares/discounts, WELCOME15,
addresses, "Sam R.", plate 4WX 812, ratings, ETAs, driver counts.
Tier names/capacities and FAQ questions are real production values.
